policy.authenticityPrinciple: Listening must require genuine audio processing. Written transcripts must not be shown prior to the first attempt. Generic browser TTS must never be labeled as authentic JLPT exam audio.
policy.copyrightPrinciple: No redistribution of copyrighted commercial JLPT prep CDs or proprietary test audio without explicit publisher licensing. Use only Creative Commons, public broadcaster educational programming, and Japan Foundation open resources.

audioProvenanceClassifications.definition: Official public educational broadcast or open foundation materials with clear licensing (e.g., NHK World, Japan Foundation Irodori).
Locally recorded audio with native Japanese speakers under explicit project release consent.
High-fidelity neural text-to-speech used solely for micro-pronunciation drills and clearly labeled as synthetic; NEVER presented as authentic JLPT audio.
Multi-speaker dialogue following exact JLPT timing, chime cues, and acoustic environment standards.
